title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI **Data Tech – Data Science** is a central team responsible for building and managing **data\-centric and AI\-driven applications and capabilities** that support all major business verticals across the firm, including **ESG, Index, Analytics, and Real Estate**. The team enables high\-quality financial decision\-making by delivering scalable, reliable, and compliant AI solutions used by some of the world’s largest financial services organizations.
We are seeking **AI Engineers at Associate and Senior Associate levels** to support MSCI’s **AI adoption journey**, with a focus on **machine learning, NLP, GenAI, LLMs, and agentic AI systems**. These roles are hands\-on and engineering\-focused, centered on building, integrating, and operationalizing AI capabilities across internal platforms and client\-facing products.
Your Key Responsibilities:
**AI \& Data Science Application Development*** Design, develop, and maintain data science and AI\-driven applications that support multiple MSCI business lines.
* Implement machine learning, NLP, and GenAI solutions that move from experimentation to production.
* Build and integrate LLM\-powered capabilities such as retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), summarization, classification, extraction, and reasoning into enterprise platforms.

**GenAI, LLMs \& Agentic AI*** Develop and enhance solutions using LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Apply best practices in prompt engineering, orchestration, evaluation, and monitoring to ensure consistent, reliable AI outputs.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including text processing, embeddings, and vector\-based retrieval.

**Platform Integration \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration*** Support teams across Data, Technology, and Engineering to integrate AI services with MSCI’s data science platforms and APIs.
* Engage with content expert teams to understand MSCI datasets, data delivery platforms, and business workflows.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Quality Assurance, Data Operations, and IT Infrastructure across all stages of the development lifecycle.

**Production Readiness \& Engineering Excellence*** Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise standards for scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Follow strong software engineering best practices, including test\-driven development, code reviews, refactoring, and clean system design.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps processes to enable continuous integration, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems.

**AI Governance, Risk \& Compliance*** Ensure AI and GenAI solutions comply with MSCI’s data governance, security, and responsible AI standards.
* Implement controls to support model transparency, traceability, auditability, and reproducibility, especially for LLM\-based systems.
* Apply guardrails to mitigate hallucinations, bias, data leakage, and misuse in AI outputs.
* Ensure appropriate handling of confidential, sensitive, and regulated data in accordance with firm policies.
* Partner with Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Information Security teams to support reviews, audits, and regulatory requirements related to AI systems.


Your skills and experience that will help you excel:
**Required*** 4–7 years of relevant experience in data science, AI engineering, or applied machine learning roles.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Python.
* Solid foundation in machine learning, NLP, and statistical modeling, including data exploration and visualization.
* Hands\-on experience or projects involving LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, or agentic AI systems.
* Experience delivering AI/ML solutions into production environments.
* Understanding of text processing and unstructured data.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices (TDD, refactoring, modular design, version control).
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and delivery\-oriented mindset.

**Preferred / Nice to Have*** Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Familiarity with DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of data governance, responsible AI, or model risk management concepts.
* Prior experience in financial services or other regulated environments.


About MSCI: **What we offer you*** Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi\-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride \& Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.


At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry\-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research\-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private\-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

**About This Role**
**About this Role**
 BlackRock Global Markets and Index Investments (BGM) brings together BlackRock’s index equity, index fixed income, global trading, securities lending, cash management, ETF markets, and financing and financial resource management businesses to deliver investment, trading, financing and risk management excellence for clients every minute of every day.
   

  

  

  

 The AI Office within BlackRock Global Markets is a function focused on transforming our businesses with the use of AI, with 3 specific goals : scaling the investment process to increase productivity, generating insights for performance and identifying revenue opportunities to grow our business. We will achieve these goals by delivering on a cohesive AI strategy for BGM, helping drive prioritization and governance and connecting with partners across the Firm  on AI initiatives. Also critical is the acceleration of our execution plans for AI, helping run pilots and proof of concepts to final deployed products and the incubation of AI DNA into BGM, bringing in new skills to make us better technologists and help amplify our collective impact. Within the AI office, we are looking to setup an AI Engineering team, specifically focused on scaling AI Research to production quality products and solutions
   

  

**Job Purpose/Background**
 The BGM AI office is looking for a strong individual contributor to help with the establishment of the AI Engineering team whose primary job responsibilities include working with the Research and Business teams to understand specific goals and deliverables and working to convert initial research to end state products/solutions that can be deployed to production. The team will focus on partnering with central functions to build on Firm provided platforms and frameworks. The work will also involve building a reusable toolkit for use by in\-business partners and helping raise the AI skillset for all of BGM.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build AI engineering solutions, both LLM and ML based and ensure production quality design and deployment
* Partner with Research teams across BGM to take proof of concepts to products and solutions
* Create common tools and platform solutions that can be useful across multiple BGM use cases, leveraging and adapting Firm technology where applicable e.g. trustworthy AI, model testing, pdf parsing tools
* Work with BGM’s data engineering teams to source new datasets for AI modeling and prepare existing ones for AI use
* Work with BLK’s central AI office and other AI\-forward teams at BlackRock, especially in Investment organizations to identify synergies and opportunities to partner
* Create alignment and help build a community with AI, Research and data teams in Gurgaon and within BGM globally



**Skills \& Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in the Financial services industry in an Engineering role that requires knowledge of investment workflows and products
* Bachelor’s level education with a focus on engineering, computer science, statistics, mathematics or related fields
* Experience with creating production\-quality software based on research
* Experience with emerging LLM offerings from industry leaders
* Experience in python \& related framework/libraries
* Experience with data engineering (ETLs) and analytical tools (Tableau, PowerBI etc.)
* Experience in modeling including machine learning, econometrics / statistical analysis and various optimization techniques
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills

We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation.  **innovative problem solvers** 
 who add value through talent and technology. We hire for
 **long\-term growth and fulfillment** 
 while fostering a
 **people\-first culture**

 **Be the Light** 
 to the world around us. With access to talent in 50\+ countries and delivery capabilities globally, we deliver world\-class technical and talent services to Fortune 500 clients to power innovation and transformation.
 



  





 We hire for people who embody our Shared Values: Everyone Matters, We Take Care of Each Other, Leadership is Here to Serve, High Character and Hard Work Above All Else, Always Know Where You Stand, Unity in Diversity, and Hustle \& Grit.
 



  





 These values are the fabric of our company. This is who we are, this is what we live by, and this is what shapes everything we do.
 



  





**ABOUT THIS ROLE**




 Evergreen’s AI Foundry team is hiring senior engineers to build production\-grade AI systems at scale. In this single requisition, we’re hiring across three specializations and will match candidates to the best fit through the interview process:
 



  





 • Track A — Generative AI (LLMs \& RAG)
 



 • Track B — AI Agent Engineering (Multi Agent Orchestration)
 



 • Track C — Computer Vision (OCR, Detection, Video Analytics)
 



  





 You’ll design, ship, and optimize AI solutions that integrate with enterprise platforms and data, leveraging one of the hyperscaler cloud services. Please indicate your primary track(s) in the application.
 



  





**WHAT YOU’LL DO**




**Core (Applies to all Tracks)** 




 • Design and deliver production AI services with clear SLOs for latency, cost, reliability, and scalability.
 



 • Partner across data, security, and product teams to integrate AI into real enterprise workflows with proper governance, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
 



 • Establish evaluation frameworks and telemetry for model quality, groundedness, and safety; turn insights into continuous improvements.
 



 • Write high\-quality Python and build robust pipelines on Azure (plus cross\-cloud integration as needed).
 



 • Document architectures, patterns, and runbooks; mentor engineers and contribute to reusable components.
 



  





**Track Options (Role\-Specific Additions)** 




**Track A — Senior Generative AI Engineer (LLMs \& Advanced RAG)** 




 • Design and implement LLM based applications using Azure OpenAI and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI.
 



 • Develop prompt engineering strategies and maintain prompt registries.
 



 • Build retrieval augmented generation (RAG) with vector databases for domain grounding (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone).
 



 • Define and automate LLM evaluation for accuracy, groundedness, and safety.
 



 • Collaborate with agent and ML teams to embed LLM capabilities across workflows.
 



  





**Track B — Senior AI Agent Engineer (Multi Agent Orchestration)** 




 • Build multi agent systems with frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
 



 • Integrate tools, APIs, and ML services; manage state, memory, and planning.
 



 • Implement guardrails, safety checks, RBAC, and human in the loop mechanisms.
 



 • Develop monitoring/observability for agent reliability and outcomes; tune for cost and latency.
 



 • Leverage workflow engines, queues, and distributed systems patterns.
 



  





**Track C — Senior Computer Vision Engineer (OCR, Detection, Video)** 




 • Build and deploy CV models with PyTorch using YOLO / Detectron2 (and related libraries).
 



 • Implement OCR and document understanding pipelines for structured data extraction.
 



 • Optimize inference using ONNX, TensorRT, and GPU acceleration.
 



 • Integrate CV outputs with LLMs/agents for end to end multimodal solutions.
 



 • Ensure privacy and security for image/video data.
 



  





**WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED**




 • Bachelor’s in computer science, AI/ML, or related field; or equivalent practical experience.
 



 • 5\+ years of hands on software development in at least one of:
 



 •AI/ML (incl. LLMs/RAG), backend/distributed systems, or computer vision.
 



 • Strong Python; production experience with at least one of: LangChain / LangGraph / Semantic Kernel (or equivalent), PyTorch, and modern orchestration patterns.
 



 • Cloud ML experience with Azure AI Foundry / Azure ML; familiarity with Google Vertex AI and/or AWS SageMaker is a plus.
 



 • Working knowledge of evaluation/telemetry for model quality, safety, and groundedness; commitment to responsible AI.
 



 • Track record of shipping secure, compliant solutions in enterprise settings.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications**

 Kloth is building a radically new way to shop fashion online — one where an intelligent agent understands your body, intent, and taste, and helps you arrive at confident decisions instead of endless scrolling.
 





 Fashion is a deeply sensory category. Size charts, filters, and static images fail because they don’t understand fit, feel, or context. Kloth’s agentic, context\-aware shopping experience is designed to change that.
 





 This is not a storefront. It’s an adaptive, confidence\-driven shopping journey.
   





**Founding Team** 

**Khanaz K A — Founder \& CEO** 



* 14\+ years in e\-commerce and product leadership. IIM Ahmedabad MBA.
* Former Amazon (Prime \& Growth) product leader; ex\-CPO at Simpl.
* Built and scaled checkout and growth systems used by 1000\+ brands.



**Prateek Chugh — Co\-founder \& CBO** 



* One of the strongest sales and growth leaders in India.
* Formerly led sales and growth at Oyo, Classplus, and Simpl.
* Deep experience building GTM engines from zero to scale.



**Aditya Todi — Co\-founder \& CTO** 



* IIIT Hyderabad alumnus.
* Founding engineer across multiple startups.
* A first\-principles thinker with savant\-level coding ability and strong systems intuition.


**The Role** 


 We’re looking for a founding Machine Learning engineer to own and architect the core visual intelligence of Kloth. You will research, design, and build the proprietary generative models that allow users to visualize fit and style on their own bodies with high fidelity. This is a foundational applied research and engineering role with real ownership over the company’s core IP.
